confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Berlin price levels; no live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable, while July hostel and hotel rates are least certain because peak-season pricing varies widely. Beer assumes a 0.5 L draft lager. Cocktail and wine were set from typical Berlin prices and sanity-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.2x and 1.5x beer). EUR-based estimates were translated to USD at an assumed EUR/USD level of about 1.16 from general knowledge, not a live rate. The FX value comes from a search summary restricted to rba.gov.au that quotes the RBA's 14 October 2026 figure; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single city was used as a direct proxy. Prices were positioned from general knowledge of German metropolitan levels, with Berlin generally at or below Munich and Hamburg for dining and hotels and well below Western European capitals such as Paris and Amsterdam.
